title: TimeRSI: Towards Self-Improved Agentic Deployment for Time-Series Foundation Models

claim.summary: TimeRSI has a coding agent revise preprocessing, feature, context-selection and post-processing code around a frozen TSFM using window-level forecast errors, then selects among retained pipelines per origin from their errors on similar completed windows.

modules.name: Origin-aligned deployment-pipeline revision
modules.scope_reason: The agent edits a four-stage pipeline whose output is point and quantile forecasts for the next H steps, revised from forecast errors on historical windows.
evidence_locators: PDF p.2; passage beginning "The loop starts from direct"
PDF p.7; passage beginning "The evaluator supplies the same"

modules.name: Similarity-weighted historical pipeline selection
modules.scope_reason: Pipelines are ranked by MASE relative to the reference forecast on similar completed windows, so the selector is tied to forecast outputs.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "T IME RSI therefore selects"
PDF p.8; passage beginning "For each candidate and historical"
